description:
A reader goes to great lengths to obtain an invitation to a secret club, run for a select few members. Finally holding the coveted invite, they arrive at the club, excited to indulge in pleasures of their choosing, only to encounter a man with a gentle, beautiful appearance but a wildly inappropriate personality.

Enduring every insult—disgust, filth, and countless humiliations—the reader finds themselves increasingly aroused by the man’s abusive behavior. But when the intensity becomes almost too much to bear, the reader seizes a chance to escape while the man’s attention wavers.

Determined not to flee entirely, the reader notices a conveniently exposed opening and sets a trap to catch him. Will the man fall for the trap…?!
